title: Toot & Toot Intelligence Platform
subtitle: Geospatial Analytics & Queue Optimization (500x Speedup)
summary: React dashboards for 200k+ geospatial map points using Superfetch (30x faster) and Laravel Horizon queues (500x faster trip processing), integrated with Power BI.
overview: Urban mobility analytics and market intelligence platform for UK ride-hailing services, combining high-throughput backend APIs with real-time geospatial dashboards.
roleDescription: Head of Software Development at Evoke Mobile.
responsibilities: Resolved critical rendering bottleneck on React frontend handling 200k+ map coordinates using Superfetch strategy (30x loading speedup).
Re-architected backend ecosystem with asynchronous Laravel Horizon queue workers for trip processing (500x speedup).
Built automated data pipelines feeding executive Power BI dashboards.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: UI freezing when rendering massive geospatial datasets on interactive maps.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented incremental paginated fetching with Superfetch and client-side data clustering.
